attributes.name: steady_repetition
attributes.text: The same movement repeats many times at a steady rhythm.
attributes.definition: One movement cycle repeats more than three times with roughly even timing.

attributes.name: few_repetitions
attributes.text: A movement is done two or three times, then stops.
attributes.definition: A distinct stroke or beat repeats a small number of times, not continuously.

attributes.name: single_occurrence
attributes.text: The movement happens once and does not repeat.
attributes.definition: There is one main stroke or reach in the whole clip, followed by return or rest.

attributes.name: held_still_pose
attributes.text: A pose is held still for a while in the middle of the action.
attributes.definition: After the body reaches a target posture, all joints stay nearly fixed for a clear pause before returning.

attributes.name: sudden_burst
attributes.text: The main movement is sudden and very fast.
attributes.definition: The key phase is a short, abrupt burst much faster than the rest of the action.

attributes.name: slow_smooth
attributes.text: The movement is slow and smooth throughout.
attributes.definition: All phases happen at a slow, even pace without abrupt changes in speed.

attributes.name: sustained_small_motion
attributes.text: Small hand movements continue for the whole clip with little change.
attributes.definition: Low-amplitude hand motion continues throughout without a clear start-hold-end structure.

attributes.name: ends_in_new_state
attributes.text: The body ends in a different posture or place than it started.
attributes.definition: The final pose or position clearly differs from the initial one, rather than returning to the start.

attributes.name: two_sided_sequence
attributes.text: One side of the body acts, then the other side does a similar act.
attributes.definition: A movement made by one arm or side is followed by a matching movement with the other side.

attributes.name: preparatory_wind_up
attributes.text: A limb first moves backward before the main forward movement.
attributes.definition: The main fast motion is preceded by a clear opposite movement (draw back or crouch) that loads it.

attributes.name: shrug_at_end
attributes.text: The action ends with the shoulders lifting and hands pulling at the front.
attributes.definition: In the last phase the shoulders lift or bounce and the hands pull down or forward at the front of the chest or shoulders.

attributes.name: ends_with_hands_low_front
attributes.text: The action ends with both hands coming down together in front of the body.
attributes.definition: In the final phase both hands meet or come near each other in front of the body and then lower toward the waist or floor.

attributes.name: brief_meet_then_withdraw
attributes.text: Hands meet for a brief moment and then pull back.
attributes.definition: Two hands (of one or two people) come together, touch only briefly without a hold, and then separate.
